detail.goal: Search Wikipedia for the company 'Bank of America' using the search box, click the matching suggestion in the dropdown to open its article, then read the company's ISIN, industry, and headquarters from the infobox.

detail.target: link named "Search" labelledBy "Search Wikipedia [ctrl-option-f]" in frame "root"
detail.why: This is the search input on the Wikipedia main page (labelled "Search Wikipedia"). I need to type the company name here to search.

detail.target: combobox named "Search Wikipedia" labelledBy "Search Wikipedia" in frame "root"
detail.why: Typing into the focused Wikipedia search box to invoke the suggestion dropdown for "Bank of America".

detail.target: option named "Bank of America American multinational banking and financial services corporation" labelledBy "Bank of America" in frame "root"
detail.why: This is the top search suggestion matching the exact company name "Bank of America" (described as the American multinational banking corporation). Clicking it opens the Bank of America article.
The infobox row labelled "ISIN" contains the company's ISIN code (US0605051046), which is one of the requested values.
The infobox row labelled "Industry" contains the company's industry (Financial services), which is one of the requested values.
The infobox row labelled "Headquarters" contains the company's headquarters location, which is one of the requested values.

detail.summary: Searched Wikipedia for "Bank of America", clicked the matching top suggestion, and opened the article at en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bank_of_America. From the company infobox I extracted: ISIN = US0605051046; Industry = Financial services; Headquarters = Bank of America Corporate Center, Charlotte, North Carolina, U.S. (corporate/legal) / Bank of America Tower (Manhattan), New York City, U.S. (executive).
